PlaytestSession.title: PlaytestSession
PlaytestSession.description: Represents a single playtest session for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the playtest session.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated the playtest session. (Relationship: User 1:N PlaytestSession)

gameVersion.description: The version of the game being playtested.

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the playtest session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the playtest session ended.

sessionData.description: A string containing serialized game data associated with this playtest session.

notes.description: Any notes or feedback provided by the user during or after the playtest session.

firestore.reasoning: The data structure is designed to securely store playtest session data for individual users. It leverages path-based ownership to ensure that only the authenticated user can access their own playtest sessions. This eliminates the need for complex security rules involving `get()` calls, which improves performance and security. Specifically, all `PlaytestSession` documents are stored under `/users/{userId}/playtest_sessions/{playtestSessionId}`, creating a clear ownership hierarchy and enabling atomic operations (transactions/batches). This design follows the principle of Authorization Independence (CRITICAL) by directly associating data with the user's ID in the path, avoiding the need to check parent documents for authorization information. This structure supports the required QAPs by ensuring that list operations on `/users/{userId}/playtest_sessions` are inherently secure, as only the authenticated user can access documents under their respective `userId`.
